subject: RM_SheddingVenomvine
departures: lopsided stand: the sunward face is bare and the opposite face still carries its thorns
the bare sunward side is pale, scarred cane, not green leafy stems
the stand is tall and ragged, with no tidy bush or arching blackberry-cane shape
a long rust-coloured V of shed thorns fans out downwind across the ground from the plant
thorns are big enough to read on their own as litter on the ground, not fine bramble prickles
